messages.text: Where is my order? Order #····-A, email (email hidden)
I'll pull that up now.
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)

Your Magic Miner 40T order (with the Miner Duster and Power Kit) is paid and hasn't shipped yet. It ships October 31, going to (address hidden).

We wrote to you on September 27 about that date, when the manufacturer upgraded the hardware, so nothing has changed since.

You can follow the incoming batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking goes to this email as soon as the label prints.
Thank you very much.  Have a great day.
Used the chat-interview skill
Ran dossier.py (chat-interview skill)
Before you go, one thing: back in July you sent one of the Nexus S1 units back to us. What made you return that one rather than troubleshoot it?

I didn't have the option to troubleshoot it.  I was asked for a picture and what was going on with it.  I guess when I said I had sparks coming off the board when plugging it in, you guys just had me return it.

Sparks on plug-in is the one fault we don't troubleshoot, so that was the right call, and you got the replacement on Shop···· in August.

Follow-up, since it matters: has that replacement S1 run clean since, or have you seen anything odd at the power input on any of the others?
Nope everything is running great.  I have a NerdOctAxe 3.1, 3 Nexus S1.2 and 3 NerdQaxe++4.8 all being powered by my Mean Well RSP-1500.

Nice rig, one RSP-1500 feeding seven boards is tidy.

Last one: with the 40T on its way, are you planning to keep growing the farm, or is that the setup finished?
Pluse my Bitfortun BS-2

Right, the BS-2 too, that's eight units plus the 40T landing. Solid little farm.

Thanks for answering, that's genuinely useful to us. Your 40T ships October 31 and the tracking comes by email.

If you've been happy with how we've handled things, a review would mean a lot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

And you're welcome in our Discord for new gear and help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Thank you, I'll check out Discord, I'm getting a little more comfortable in there.  I will always be happy to leave a positive review, I noticed the other day my reviews were side by side.  That kinda looked staged, if you know what I mean.

Ha, I know what you mean. Trustpilot stacks reviews by date, so two from the same person land next to each other. Nothing we arrange, and we never touch how they sit there.

Appreciate you writing them at all, and the answers today. Enjoy Discord, JD is in there as @nullhashrate if you ever want a hardware question answered fast.
ok, thank you  Have a great day
You too. Watch for the tracking mail around October 31, and shout if anything comes up before then.
will do
Perfect. Happy mining, and enjoy the rest of your day.
